milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the blue wall banners on the south face of the red nether brick structure and face them. The banner cluster center is at spawn-relative (9, 3, 6). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the banners.

Uses inventory_has because mining a red nether brick wall with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player needs to mine at least 1 red nether brick wall block (the one at (9,1,9) separating them from the silverfish chamber). inventory_has is preferred over mine_block for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind='mob' and max_count=0 because this is a combat/kill task. The silverfish is spawned at spawn-relative (9,1,10) inside the hollow structure. A generous box of ±20 blocks around the structure center ensures the silverfish remains within the detection zone until actually killed, preventing false positives from the mob wandering out of a small box.
